name: Shizuoka Gas Co., Ltd.
summary: Shizuoka Gas Co., Ltd. produces, supplies, and sells city gas in Japan. It operates through Gas, and LPG and Other Energy Services segments. The company sells and supplies gas and liquefied natural gas; liquefied petroleum gas and related equipment; and provides on-site energy services. It is also involved in equipment installation and contract work. Further, the company sells gas appliances; and undertakes contracts for gas related construction works. The company was incorporated in 1910 and is headquartered in Shizuoka, Japan.
